title: Reference-based blue animatronic v003 - visually refined editable test model

acceptance_criteria.description: Front preview exists; every requested view must also pass worker gates
Four-view test-model review: complete rounded head/body silhouette and coherent segmented limbs broadly follow reference proportions
Reference features present: two incisors, muzzle, rounded striped glasses, ears, headphones, tuft, hat, bow, bands and toes; v002 visible defects corrected
Named separate parts and rigid armature; no missing major components or gross floating hat/panel; test model is not claimed as production-ready topology
